minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.purpose: Observe legitimate startup to locate actual code/module offsets and metadata call relationships for command-line/named-mapping/socket APIs, without accessing contents. Do not repeat bare-client or offline-update-failure probes as if they solve this gap.
minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.preconditions: Known complete legitimate resources/installation and a recoverable isolated environment; keep user-confirmed Win7 settings without repeated checks. Launcher currently needs update connectivity to pass its observed error path; any network or elevation/child scope must be separately concrete. Do not enable it now.
minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.data_requested_if_officially_supported: Process/module identities and lifetimes, module-relative callsite/return-address metadata for GetCommandLine/OpenFileMapping/MapViewOfFile and actual socket imports/resolution; no returned command strings, shared-memory contents, buffer data, credentials, account IDs, memory dumps, packet/session payloads or full logs.
minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.permission_limit: Normal official diagnostic/debugging path only. Observer attach/instrumentation privileges or any required higher privilege are not preapproved. If debugger detection/protection/access refusal prevents observation, stop; no stealth, patched checks or disabling anti-cheat.
minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.risks_and_stops: Administrator launcher may update/write XML or executable files and spawn updater/config/patcher/game. Missing resources, new binary/driver/UAC/terms, login requirement, unapproved network, anti-cheat alert or access denial: stop and report; do not fabricate argv/IPC. Network contact can expose Windows/WinINet state even without game login.
minimum_dynamic_evidence_proposal.cannot_prove: Metadata-only localization cannot establish frame/authentication semantics or official server acceptance. Authenticated operation or sanitized network vectors would require a later explicit, permitted scope; no blanket approval is implied.
